$comment: Branch and commit conventions, read by the PR checks and by commitlint. Explained in docs/guides/workflow.md#commit-messages. Change them in a PR, like any rule.

types.feat: Something a user can now do that they could not before
types.fix: Something that should work and did not
types.test: Tests added or fixed, no product change
types.chore: Anything else that does not touch the product (tooling, config, releases)

scopes.auth: Sign up, log in, sessions, OAuth
scopes.plans: Group plans: creation, voting, chat, closing
scopes.recommendations: The recommendation engine and Surprise me
scopes.llm: The language model and its explanations
scopes.game: Points, levels, badges, map to reveal, ranking
scopes.moderation: Reports, blocks and the moderation queue
scopes.public-api: The public API and its keys
scopes.ui: Design system components and tokens in code
scopes.web: The web app as a whole
scopes.github: GitHub settings, templates and the board
